summary: The .did-pill (CopyPill: DID and handle in Settings > Account) uses var(--border-focus) and var(--border-strong), and neither token is defined anywhere. The :focus-visible outline therefore resolves to unset, so the copy button has no visible focus ring, and the hover border falls back to currentColor.
fix: Use outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring) on line 627 and border-color: var(--border-hover) on line 623 (both tokens exist).

summary: The site drawer renders /brand/wordmark/certified_wordmark_black.svg (pure black), and .site-drawer__wordmark has no dark-mode rule. The wordmark is invisible on the dark drawer surface. Every other wordmark (top bar, footer, mobile sidebar) has :root[data-theme="dark"] { filter: invert(1) }.
fix: Add :root[data-theme="dark"] .site-drawer__wordmark { filter: invert(1); } to site-drawer.css, matching layout.css:529/1632/3216.

summary: .delete-record-dialog__target uses font-family: var(--font-jetbrains-mono), ui-monospace, monospace. --font-jetbrains-mono is not defined (only --font-mono and next/font --font-inter/--font-headline exist), so the whole declaration becomes invalid at computed-value time. The type-to-confirm target name then inherits the body font instead of monospace, which defeats the 'case + whitespace are unambiguous' intent.
fix: Replace with font-family: var(--font-mono), ui-monospace, monospace.

summary: AppDialogHeader's close X is a hand-rolled 24x24 button (h-6 w-6). Every AppDialog and ResponsiveDialog in the app uses it. This bypasses <Button size="icon"> (hard rule 8) and gives a 24px touch target on mobile, below the 44px minimum. It also uses a focus-visible box-shadow instead of the canonical outline.
fix: Render <Button size="icon" variant="ghost" aria-label="Close" className="absolute right-1 top-1"> (44px mobile / 40px desktop). Adjust header padding if the larger box needs room.

summary: On mobile the toast stack is fixed at bottom-0 with p-4 at z --z-feedback. That puts it directly over the fixed bottom nav (56px + safe-area), covering nav items, and it ignores env(safe-area-inset-bottom). The comment claims it 'clears the bottom-nav comfortably', but nothing offsets it.
fix: Below 800px, set bottom: calc(var(--bottom-nav-height) + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px)) (e.g. max-[799px]:bottom-[calc(var(--bottom-nav-height)+env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px))]).

summary: The '+' Create menu is a hand-rolled portal with role="menu", manual anchor math, and click-outside and Esc listeners, while the account switcher next to it already uses <Popover>. The hand-rolled menu has no arrow-key navigation and doesn't move focus into the menu on open, so it falls short of the role=menu contract (DESIGN.md §14.2 says to migrate menus to <Popover>).
fix: Replace it with <Popover>/<PopoverTrigger>/<PopoverContent portal side="bottom" align="start"> and render the three links as PopoverItem (or as menuitem Links inside PopoverContent). Then delete createAnchor and the three listener effects.

summary: .desktop-top-bar__create-item:focus-visible sets outline: none and shows only background: var(--overlay-weak). That is a faint tint, and the only keyboard focus indicator in the Create menu.
fix: Keep the hover tint but restore outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: -2px on :focus-visible (or drop the rule and let the global a:focus-visible apply).

summary:
The chrome renders the page title or breadcrumb as an

(desktop-top-bar.tsx:395/409 and navbar.tsx:309). Pages also render their own h1 (e.g. settings-panel.tsx:339 has a sr-only

Settings

), so every titled page has two h1s. On /settings the chrome h1 is just the @handle. Its aria-live="polite" also re-announces the title on every navigation.
fix:
Render the chrome title as a

/

(keep the classes) and let each page own its single h1. Drop aria-live from the title.

summary: Mobile bottom-nav destinations (Home, Explore, Create, Apps) are <button onClick={router.push}> rather than links. Long-press, open-in-new-tab and copy-link don't work, Next.js prefetch is lost, and screen readers announce buttons instead of links in a nav landmark.
fix: Render Home/Explore/Create/Apps as <Link href> (keep the Home scroll-to-top onClick when already on /home). Keep only Feedback as a <button>.

summary: The active nav item is styled (.site-drawer__item--active / .mobile-sidebar__link--active) but has no aria-current="page". The same applies to the mobile sidebar (mobile-sidebar.tsx:168) and the desktop top-bar icon links (desktop-top-bar.tsx:446-499), which have neither aria-current nor any active visual.
fix: Add aria-current={isActive ? "page" : undefined} to the drawer and sidebar links. For the top-bar icon links, compute an active state from pathname and set aria-current (a visual active style is a separate taste item, shell-33).

summary: In the account switcher, the active identity is shown only through the .account-switcher__item--active background. The items are role="menuitem" with no aria-checked/aria-current, so screen-reader users can't tell which account or group is active. The Popover primitive already supports role="menuitemradio" + aria-checked.
fix: Render the identity rows as role="menuitemradio" aria-checked={isActive}, or use <PopoverItem selected={...}> in the desktop popover. Mirror the state in the BottomSheet variant.

summary: The sign-in modal uses Tailwind max-[520px]: variants (lines 84, 90), a non-canonical breakpoint. components.css:1129 notes that a 520px block was removed for exactly this reason.
fix: Switch to max-[799px]: (the canonical below-desktop breakpoint), or drop the responsive tweak.

summary: The 'New password' and 'Confirm password' inputs have no autoComplete="new-password". Password managers won't offer to generate or save the new password, and some will autofill the current one.
fix: Add autoComplete="new-password" to both inputs (lines 156 and 166).

summary: The email change, email confirm, and password reset flows (email-section.tsx:225/286, password-section.tsx:141) put their Inputs in plain <div>s with onClick Save buttons, so pressing Enter in a field does nothing. Elsewhere in settings (app-passwords, import-as-group) a <form onSubmit> is used.
fix: Wrap each field group in <form onSubmit={(e)=>{e.preventDefault(); handleSave()}}> and give the primary button type="submit".

summary: Revoke on an app password fires immediately with no confirmation or undo. It is irreversible and breaks any client using that password. Every row says just 'Revoke', with no accessible name for the target.
fix: Gate it behind <ConfirmDialog> ('Revoke "{name}"? Apps using it will be signed out.'). Add aria-label={`Revoke ${p.name}`} to each button.

summary: <ul role="listbox"> contains <li> rows holding native checkboxes, plus an empty-state <li>. listbox requires role="option" children and its own keyboard model, so this is invalid ARIA and hides the checkbox semantics in some screen readers.
fix: Remove role="listbox". Keep a plain <ul aria-label=...> (or role="group") of checkbox rows.

summary: The floating .feedback-trigger (rendered by components/layout/feedback-trigger.tsx) uses ad-hoc box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.15) and, on hover, 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.2). landing.css is exempt only for raw palette colors, not for the shadow rule.
fix: Use box-shadow: var(--shadow-md), and var(--shadow-lg) on hover.

summary: The .acting-as-bar__switch ('Switch to personal') button is 28px tall, including below 800px where the bar is fixed at 44px. That is under the 44px touch minimum. Its focus ring is the global --focus-ring (#5e5e5e light / #a0a0a8 dark), drawn on the inverted --btn-primary-bg bar (#111 / #f5f5f7), giving about 2.9:1 and 2.5:1 contrast, below the 3:1 non-text minimum.
fix: Below 800px give it min-height: 44px (or extend the hit area with padding / a pseudo-element). Add .acting-as-bar__switch:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--btn-primary-fg); outline-offset: 2px; }.

summary: CopyPill (DID and handle) and WalletAddress (wallet-address.tsx:63) signal success only by swapping the button's aria-label. Screen readers don't announce aria-label changes on a focused element, so the copy gives no audible confirmation. The aria-label also replaces the visible value, so the DID itself isn't read.
fix: Add a visually hidden {copied ? `${label} copied` : ""} (or call the toast). Make the label 'Copy DID' and leave the value as visible text, or use aria-describedby.

summary:
The feedback textarea and email field are 'labelled' by a

plus a duplicate aria-label. The visible text isn't a
fix: Turn the prompts into <label htmlFor="feedback-message"> / <label htmlFor="feedback-email"> (or pass label= to Textarea/Input) and drop the aria-label props.

summary: In ErrorMessage, the text column is flex-1 without min-w-0 or break-words, so long unbroken error strings (URLs, DIDs, server messages) overflow the alert box. The title is a hard-coded <h4> wherever the component lands (e.g. under the settings h2), which skips heading levels. The AlertCircle icon isn't aria-hidden.
fix:
Use className="min-w-0 flex-1" with break-words on the

. Render the title as

. Add aria-hidden to the icon.

summary: The EmptyState title uses font-headline text-[1.125rem] font-semibold, an arbitrary size equal to h4, instead of the canonical text-h4 utility. The h3 level is also hard-coded regardless of where the empty state is placed.
fix: Use className="font-headline text-h4". Optionally add a headingLevel/as prop (default h3) so callers can keep the outline correct.

summary: .sx-panel__title (the settings page h2) is 1.5rem desktop / 1.25rem mobile. Neither size is on the canonical scale (h2 1.75, h3 1.375, h4 1.125).
fix: Snap to the h3 step (1.375rem / line-height 1.4) on desktop and h4 (1.125rem) on mobile, or apply text-h3 font-headline in settings-panel.tsx:360.

summary: Several icon-only controls are raw <button>s with bespoke classes instead of <Button size="icon">: the social-graph 'Back to sync options' arrow, .site-drawer__close (36px), .desktop-top-bar__menu (36px), .navbar__back-overlay (40px on mobile), banner.tsx:126 dismiss (28px), toast.tsx:305 dismiss (~24px), bottom-sheet.tsx:109 close (32px). Several fall below 44px on touch.
fix: Migrate each to <Button size="icon" variant="ghost" aria-label=...>, which gives 44px on mobile and 40px on desktop.

summary: 'Resend code' reuses the unrelated .username-card__domain-btn class as a raw <button>, next to <Button size="sm"> siblings in the same action row. Hover, disabled and focus states differ from its neighbours.
fix: Use <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick=... disabled={saving}><RefreshCw size={14} aria-hidden /> Resend code</Button>.

summary:
Success messages ('Password updated successfully.', 'Email confirmed.' at email-section.tsx:350) are plain

s that appear after an async save. They aren't announced, and Email's message disappears after 4s.
fix: Add role="status" to the .password-section__status success paragraphs.

summary: The mobile hamburger and the mobile account-switcher trigger (line 230) declare aria-haspopup="menu", but they open a modal Drawer and a BottomSheet dialog, not a menu.
fix: Use aria-haspopup="dialog" (or drop it) on both triggers.

summary: The isDesktop ? <Popover>... branch in the mobile Navbar is unreachable: line 130 already returns null when isDesktop. The account switcher list is maintained in three places as a result.
fix: Delete the desktop Popover branch and keep the mobile trigger + BottomSheet only.

summary: Loading labels use three periods: 'Connecting...' (sign-in-modal.tsx:77), 'Sending...' (feedback-modal.tsx:176), 'Redirecting...' (provider-redirect-overlay.tsx:13). Settings uses the ellipsis character ('Saving…', 'Writing…').
fix: Replace '...' with '…' in those three strings.

summary: LoadingSpinner announces 'Loading' twice: the Brandmark carries title="Loading" (role=img) and a sibling sr-only Loading sits inside the same role="status".
fix: Make the Brandmark decorative (decorative / title="" + aria-hidden) and keep the sr-only span.

summary: @media (max-width: 1099.98px) is the only use of this form. The rest of the codebase writes 'below 1100' as max-width: 1099px, mirroring the 799px convention.
fix: Change to @media (max-width: 1099px).

summary: The Button base classes use transition-all. That animates layout properties such as width and padding when the loading spinner toggles, and goes against the guideline to list transitioned properties explicitly.
fix: Use transition-[background-color,border-color,color,opacity,transform] duration-150.

summary: The desktop icon nav (Home, Apps, Profile, Settings, Help) gives no visual indication of the current section. Only hover changes the colour, so on /settings or /apps nothing in the chrome shows where you are.
fix: Proposal: an active treatment matching the bottom-nav (color: var(--fg-primary) + heavier strokeWidth, or a 2px underline using var(--fg-primary)), keyed off pathname.

summary: The signed-out 'Sign in' button is an image of a solid black pill with white text (certified_signin_black.svg) with no dark-mode variant. On the dark canvas (#18181b) the pill's edge disappears and it reads as floating text. The mobile navbar already swapped to <Button variant="secondary">Sign in</Button> for a similar reason.
fix: Proposal: either use <Button variant="primary" size="sm">Sign in</Button> (theme-aware tokens), or ship a light SVG variant swapped under [data-theme="dark"].

summary: On desktop /settings the breadcrumb shows only '@handle'. The word 'Settings' appears nowhere visible (the h1 is sr-only), so the page title is just the selected sub-page h2 ('Account').
fix: Proposal: make the breadcrumb '@handle / Settings' (right: { text: "Settings", href: "/settings" }) so the chrome names the page.

summary: Bottom-nav items are icon-only on touch: Tooltip is suppressed on coarse pointers, and there is no visible label. The CSS comments still describe an 'icon+label cluster'. Icons like LayoutGrid ('Apps') and Newspaper ('Home') are ambiguous without text.
fix: Proposal: add a small 0.6875rem label under each icon (as .desktop-top-bar__icon-label already does on desktop).

summary: Sign-in renders <AppDialogHeader title="" ...>, which draws an empty header strip with a border-bottom hairline above the brandmark. The result is a visible divider with no title.
fix: Proposal: render only the close button (or add a 'borderless' option to AppDialogHeader) for title-less dialogs.

summary: A signed-out visit to /settings (or any AuthGuard route) silently router.replace('/')s away with no explanation and no return-to. The SignedOutPrompt primitive exists for this case on other personal surfaces.
fix: Proposal: render <SignedOutPrompt title="Sign in to manage your settings" .../> in place, or redirect with ?next= so sign-in returns the user to the deep link.

summary: The News section's error state ('Couldn't load posts.') has no retry. Post timestamps show only relative time with no absolute date on hover.
fix: Proposal: add a ghost 'Try again' action on error, and title={new Date(createdAt).toLocaleString()} on the <time>.

summary: The mobile-sidebar theme cycle toggle (.theme-toggle-cycle, 36x36) and the legal links (.mobile-sidebar__legal-link, 0.75rem inline text) are below 44px. Both render only under 800px.
fix: Proposal: grow .theme-toggle-cycle to 44x44 (keeping the negative margins), and give the legal links padding: 8px 0 / display:inline-block.
